info.name: Akai MPC Sample
info.author: Cutlab
info.description: The 16 pads of an MPC (notes 37-52 or 36-51, any MIDI channel) as samplers, hot cues or stem mutes. Turn on MIDI output of the pads on the MPC.

value.label: Pads 1-8: samplers 1-8, pads 9-12: deck 1 hot cues, pads 13-16: deck 2 hot cues
Pads 1-8: deck 1 hot cues 1-8, pads 9-16: deck 2 hot cues 1-8
Pads 1-4 / 5-8: mute stems of deck 1 / deck 2 (drums, bass, other, vocals), pads 9-16: hot cues
